messages.subject: Rattle crashes on XP
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I'm getting started with Rattle, and am having a stability problem
running it under Windows XP (SP2).  Rattle crashes (both itself, and
R) whenever I follow this sequence of events:

1) start Rattle
2) Load a dataset (I've done so both from an ODBC query and data entry
with the same results)
3) Choose the "Select" tab
4) Select one or more variables
5) Click either the Input or Ignore button to change their setting

Upon clicking the Input or Ignore button on the Rattle GUI, XP pops up
a dialog box "R for Windows GUI front-end has encountered a problem
and needs to close."  The error signature info is:

AppName: rgui.exe	 AppVer: 2.60.43063.0	 ModName: r.dll
ModVer: 2.60.43063.0	 Offset: 00085923

This is 100% reproducible on my system.  Any ideas what's going on?

Thanks,
Keith
